content:
Friday, November 27th 2026
![Playstation](https://tpucdn.com/images/news/playstation-v1795442328.png)
We previously reported that GTA VI had managed nearly 45 million units sold by the end of launch weekend, and, while sales have somewhat slowed since that launch, Rockstar's new open-world game has continued to rack up sales across both the Xbox Series and PlayStation 5 console platforms, with recent estimates by Alinea Analytics claiming that GTA VI has already surpassed 53 million units sold in total.
Digging further into the data, the outlet claims that the PlayStation 5 console family accounts for a staggering 75.7% share of GTA VI sales, or 40 million sales. Meanwhile, GTA VI has sold just 13 million units on Xbox. These sales figures represent an estimated total revenue figure of $4.7 billion, and player statistics show that around 250,000 players have already spent over 100 hours in-game in its first week.
![](https://tpucdn.com/img/oI6jKPwORssjmhp9_thm.jpg)
![](https://tpucdn.com/img/6tu1GDNLdmPTiPmH_thm.jpg)
While it's not a perfect analysis, since some of the games in that list were already trending downwards, since they had been launched a few months ago, but there appears to be a trend that premium game revenue dropped by as much as 24% in the week following the launch of GTA VI.
